This path uses the QuickPizza tutorial data sources, which include a Prometheus data source named **grafanacloud-play-prom** that carries real metrics from a running demo service. Querying these data sources does not count toward your Grafana Cloud usage.

The install runs from the **Demo Data Dashboards** app in the left nav. After the install finishes, Grafana refreshes the page and the alerting flow picks up in the next milestone.
Expand **More apps** in the main menu, then open **Demo Data Dashboards**.
Click **Install the Quick Pizza SRE demo**. This deploys the tutorial data sources and refreshes the page.
After install, Grafana refreshes the page and the tutorial Prometheus data source **grafanacloud-play-prom** becomes available.

Install opens the QuickPizza dashboards folder. Those dashboards use the tutorial Prometheus data source **grafanacloud-play-prom**. Next, you'll open the new alert rule page and build a query on that same data.
